ocr.notes: Text matches, but the second amount is printed '$5,000', not '£5,000'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported from New York that Jem Mace had written from England accepting Tom Allen's challenge to fight for $1,000 to $5,000, if Allen would put up a forfeit to show he meant business.

metadata.notes: No page image, so masthead and date cannot be checked. The Post-Dispatch did not exist until 1878-12; 1874 Dispatch items are the St. Louis Evening Dispatch. Dateline New York, Feb. 23.

facts.fact: Jem Mace wrote from England accepting Allen's challenge to fight for $1,000 to $5,000, on condition that Allen put up a forfeit
